svg.title: DreamCarve phase 4 wireframe: V-Carve and Inlay editors
svg.text: 06 · Operation editors: V-Carve with clearing passes (68, 70); Inlay with both boards from one project (68a, #498).
Cut before the V-bit, largest tool first; each is its own tool run.
next smaller end mill is picked
deepest cut 2.5 mm · flat floor, cleared by T1 then T2
⚠ clearing_not_descending would show here if T2 were above T1
one bit for both boards · cone height 5.5 mm
male start plane 3 mm · band floor 5 mm below the board top
flank engagement 5 mm of the 60° bit's 5.5 mm cone
base under the band 13 mm (at least 6)
No side to choose: one project cuts both boards (#498). The
female carve is on the stock; the male is on the Inlay's own
board, drawn beside the stock on the Viewport, design mirrored.
Export lists Female board and Male board; untick one to re-cut
the other alone. Thickness unset: inlay_male_board_unset here,
